entities.name: Notification procedure
entities.description: Procedure used by the network to request the UE to re-establish user-plane resources or deliver downlink signalling messages between 3GPP and non-3GPP accesses.

entities.name: NOTIFICATION message
entities.description: Message sent by the network to trigger UE actions for re-establishing user-plane resources or delivering downlink signalling.

entities.name: 5GMM-IDLE mode
entities.description: 5GMM idle state where the UE is not actively connected to the network.

entities.name: 5GMM-CONNECTED mode
entities.description: 5GMM connected state where the UE has an active connection to the network.

entities.name: MICO mode condition
entities.description: Condition where UE is not in Mobile Initiated Connection Only (MICO) mode.

entities.name: Control plane only indication condition
entities.description: Condition where all PDU sessions over 3GPP access are associated with control plane only indication.

entities.name: Voice service paging condition
entities.description: Condition where MUSIM UE supports paging indication for voice services, network has indicated support, and AMF detects downlink data related to voice service.

entities.name: No notification for control plane only sessions
entities.description: Network shall not use NOTIFICATION message to re-establish user-plane resources if all PDU sessions over 3GPP access are control plane only.

entities.name: No notification for voice service paging
entities.description: Network shall not use NOTIFICATION message over non-3GPP access when voice service paging conditions are met.

relations.description: Notification procedure involves sending NOTIFICATION message.
Notification procedure requires specific 5GMM-IDLE states depending on access type.
Notification procedure requires specific 5GMM-CONNECTED states depending on access type.
Notification procedure execution is guarded by UE not being in MICO mode.
Control plane only indication condition establishes the property that network shall not use NOTIFICATION message.
Voice service paging condition establishes the property that network shall not use NOTIFICATION message over non-3GPP access.
